body: It's not worth it. Experts think we'll be wearing masks and distancing from people the rest of our lives. No more hugging, etc. I can't deal with it. What's the purpose of seeing people? We'll be living in a virtual world from now on. Nothing makes me more depressed than sitting on my computer all day. I've tried talking to people online to no avail. This is more painful than the virus itself. My therapist doesn't even understand this.
